title: CM Punjab Kissan Card
benefit_details: Interest-free agricultural loans up to PKR 150,000 per season for seeds, fertilizers, and pesticides via Habib Bank (HBL). Direct subsidies on DAP and Urea.
eligibility: Farmers holding up to 12.5 acres agricultural land with biometric verification.
how_to_apply: Send CNIC to 8070 via SMS or visit the nearest Agriculture Extension Office / HBL Konnect shop.

title: Solar Tubewell Subsidy Scheme
benefit_details: 67% to 80% government subsidy on solarization of existing diesel/electric tubewells to reduce irrigation energy costs.
eligibility: Owners of verified tubewells with land up to 25 acres in irrigated canal commands or barani zones.
how_to_apply: Apply online via Agri Punjab portal (agripunjab.gov.pk) or through District Agriculture Officer (Water Management).

title: Smog Mitigation Machinery Subsidy
benefit_details: 60% subsidy on Super Seeders, Rice Straw Choppers, and Happy Seeders to prevent paddy residue burning.
eligibility: Individual farmers or farmer groups with minimum 10 acres cultivating rice-wheat cropping system.
how_to_apply: Submit application to Directorate General Agriculture (Field) Punjab, Lahore.

title: Certified Wheat Seed Subsidy
benefit_details: Subsidy voucher of PKR 1,000 per 50kg bag of certified rust-resistant wheat seed (Akbar-2019, Dilkash, Fakhr-e-Bhakkar).
eligibility: Registered Punjab farmers with Kissan Card.
how_to_apply: Scratch voucher code in seed bag and SMS to 8070 with CNIC.

title: Prime Minister Kissan Package
benefit_details: Targeted fertilizer subsidy (PKR 1,500/bag on DAP), markup-free loans for flood-affected areas, and duty-free import of second-hand farm implements.
eligibility: Smallholders with land under 12.5 acres registered in National Land Record / Ehsaas database.
how_to_apply: Participating commercial banks (ZTBL, NBP, HBL, Bank of Punjab) branch application.

title: ZTBL Asan Qarza Agri Loan
benefit_details: Concessionary markup loans for production (crops) and development (tractors, implements, solar, laser land levelers).
eligibility: All Pakistani farmers possessing passbook or land ownership fard.
how_to_apply: Visit nearest Zarai Taraqiati Bank Limited (ZTBL) branch with CNIC and land title documents.

title: Sindh Hari Card Scheme
benefit_details: Direct cash transfers and subsidized inputs (seeds, fertilizer) directly credited into verified peasant accounts.
eligibility: Small farmers (haris) holding up to 16 acres registered with Sindh Agriculture Department.
how_to_apply: Register at Union Council Hari Facilitation Desks or District Agriculture Office.

title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Kisan Card
benefit_details: Input subsidies and free soil testing vouchers across all districts of KP including merged districts.
eligibility: Farmers in KP owning or leasing cultivable land registered in e-agri portal.
how_to_apply: Register on KP E-Agri portal or visit Tehsil Extension Office with CNIC.

title: Balochistan Green Energy Tubewell Conversion
benefit_details: Joint federal-provincial project converting 28,000 electric tubewells to independent solar grids.
eligibility: Registered agricultural tubewell consumers of QESCO in Balochistan.
how_to_apply: Apply via QESCO / Balochistan Energy Department tubewell conversion desks.
